dataset.name: MovieLens 100K positive ratings >= 4
dataset.protocol: per-user latest 20% of positives; users with >=5 positives; all items except train positives are candidates; no sampled negatives

timing_scope: fit_transform including validation, random sketch generation, transpose preparation, decomposition, projection, variance and internal BLAS thread limiting; excluding imports, dataset loading, model construction, warmup and quality evaluation; fresh model per fit
rng_note: Integer seeds in MyMF v0.2 use PCG64; sklearn uses RandomState. The optional legacy variants use explicit RandomState for MyMF. Same seed numbers do not imply identical sketches across implementations.
